gloss: death anniversary; anniversary of someone's death

definitions.gloss: death anniversary; anniversary of someone's death
definitions.explanation: The date on which a person died, observed annually as a day of remembrance. In Japanese Buddhism, this day holds special significance for memorial services and visiting graves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命日|めいにち}だ。
examples.english: Today is the anniversary of my grandfather's death.

examples.japanese: {命日|めいにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I visit the grave every year on the anniversary of the death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命日|めいにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧、⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だった⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}えた→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: On the anniversary of my mother's death, the family gathered and offered her favorite flowers.

notes:
USAGE:
An important concept in Japanese Buddhist tradition. On the {命日|めいにち}, families typically visit the grave (⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧), offer flowers and incense, and hold memorial services. The first anniversary is called ⟦{一周忌|いっしゅうき}→一周忌：06018_isshuuki⟧, and subsequent major anniversaries (⟦{三回忌|さんかいき}→三回忌：06019_sankaiki⟧, ⟦{七回忌|ななかいき}→七回忌：28963_nanakaiki⟧, etc.) are observed with formal ceremonies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命日|めいにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to visit the grave on the death anniversary)
- {命日|めいにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧ (to offer flowers on the death anniversary)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命日|めいにち} (the anniversary of ~'s death)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忌日|きじつ}→忌日：21187_kijitsu⟧: death anniversary — more formal/literary
- {祥月命日|しょうつきめいにち}: the monthly anniversary falling on the same day as the death — the full-year anniversary specifically
